titleEn: New planters unveiled by both Fendt and Massey Ferguson
titleZh: Fendt与Massey Ferguson双双发布新型播种机
summaryZh: 在2026年美国爱荷华州Farm Progress展会上，AGCO旗下两大品牌Fendt和Massey Ferguson分别发布了新型播种机。Fendt推出其最大型号Momentum 32R30，面向大规模农场，强调高效率和精准播种；Massey Ferguson则推出N-Series窄行播种机，主打简洁可靠和模块化设计，标配Precision Planting技术。两款产品均集成AGCO的PTx精准播种技术，体现了播种设备向智能化、精准化发展的趋势。
featuredReason: 虽然本文主要涉及大田播种机械而非畜牧养殖，但AGCO旗下品牌在精准播种技术（如PTx系统、传感器、自动化控制）上的创新，对智慧农业整体发展具有参考意义。智慧畜牧从业者可关注农机智能化趋势，了解精准农业技术如何跨领域应用。
contentFull: Top Stories Beef Dairy Sheep Tillage Machinery Northern Ireland Videos Podcasts Ploughing 2026 Top Stories Beef Dairy Sheep Tillage Machinery Northern Ireland Videos Podcasts Ploughing 2026 Ploughing 2026 Visitors Guide New planters unveiled by both Fendt and Massey Ferguson ![Image 1: Joshua Kelly By Joshua Kelly September 9, 2026 6:00 PM](https:www.agriland.iefarming-newsauthorjoshua-kelly) Share this article ![Image 2: Massey Ferguson released its new N-Series planter at the 2026 Farm Progress Show in Boone, Iowa. Source: AGCO](https:www.agriland.iefarming-newsnew-planters-unveiled-by-both-fendt-and-massey-ferguson) Massey Ferguson released its new N-Series planter at the 2026 Farm Progress Show in Boone, Iowa. Source: AGCO Both Fendt and Massey Ferguson unveiled their new planter machines at the 2026 Farm Progress Show in Boone, Iowa. While the two AGCO brands have new planter technology, each is aimed at solving different problems for customers. Fendt is offering a machine "designed for large-scale farming operations seeking greater productivity and efficiency". Massey Ferguson on the other hand targets building uncomplicated and reliable machinery, and said its new planters "combine proven technology, flexible performance and straightforward ownership". Massey Ferguson Massey Ferguson's new N-Series splitnarrow row planters comes with factory-installed Precision Planting technology from AGCO's precision planting brand, PTx. PTx's 20|20 Gen3 agronomic mapping system, vSet2 vacuum seed meter (which is powered by its vDrive electric meter drive) and DeltaForce automated hydraulic downforce control system are all stock to the N-Series planters. The company said that this is combined with a modular design to "help farmers get more from every pass without adding complexity to their operation". ![Image 3: Fendt's new Momemntum planter will be available from Summer 2027 in the US and Canada. Source: Fendt](https:images.agriland.ieB2xGfdtiJ8pgpsTp5iaZiua8H4LewITzEQ47NUS-3Qrs:fit:1024:0bg:FFFFFFplainhttps:cdn.agriland.ieuploads202609fendt-momentum-planter.jpg) Fendt's new Momemntum planter will be available from Summer 2027 in the US and Canada. Source: Fendt The planters feature twin 45-bushel central seed tanks, an option liquid fertiliser capacity of up to 500gals and in-cab manual weight transfer to allow operators to adapt to changing field conditions. The N-Series comes in six configurations, ranging from 23-32 planting rows and a narrow 15-22in spacing between rows. Narrow spacing is used to increase plant populations and boost grain yields, maximising land use efficiency. It also reduces in-row plant competition as seeds are spaced further apart within each individual row. It is also noteworthy that narrower spacing means there are additional row units and thus there is a higher initial cost for these machines. Marketing manager for planters at Massey Ferguson North America, Forrest Francis spoke about the role that this machine can play in the US market. He said: "Farmers want proven technology without unnecessary complexity. "The N-Series delivers the performance producers need today while giving them the flexibility to adapt as their operation grows. "It's about putting technology to work where it can make a meaningful difference while keeping the planter straightforward to own, operate, and maintain." According to Massey Ferguson, the focus for the N-Series has been on providing long-term value beyond the planting season. The N-Series modular platform allows producers to add optional technologies, including WaveVision (which counts seeds in the tube at the bottom of the row unit, ignoring dust, dirt and debris), the company said. Other technologies such as SpeedTube (replacing gravity-drop seed tubes with an electrically driven belt system) are facilitated by the brands use of Heads Up row units, which it says features "enhanced accuracy and longevity". Fendt Fendt is expanding its Momentum planter lineup with a new 80ft, 32-row planter with 30in spacing. The Fendt Momentum32R30 is the brand's largest planter model yet. The German brand claims the new model "covers more acres per day" due to its working width and reduces fill stops thanks to its standard 130-bushel high-capacity seed system and 1,000gal fertiliser capacity. The machine uses three established AGCO technologies: Fendt SmartFrame chassis, which facilitates active terrain contouring, regardless of dips or hills; Factory-integrated Precision Planting systems (like Massey Ferguson's N-Series); Load Logic weight management, which reduces pinch rows by more evenly distributing the weight across the entire width of the frame; The planter is "engineered to maximise productivity and planting performance across every acre". Fendt North America's senior marketing manager of planters, Jason Lee spoke about the gap that Fendt hopes to fill in the market with the new Momentum planter. He said: "Large-scale growers need to cover more acres in tighter windows without sacrificing the precision that drives yield potential. "The Fendt Momentum 32R30 maximises agronomic performance and efficiency to achieve better yields, making every seed count". The Momentum 32R30 features a new five-section Vertical Contouring Toolbar (VCT), which Fendt said increases toolbar flexibility across the planter's wider operating width compared to the earlier three-section version. The machine achieves "consistent planting depth and uniform seed placement" due to the VCT letting row units to follow changing terrain more closely. Fendt has said that the planter works "efficiently" with its high-horsepower tractor lineup, including the Fendt 1000 series and newly released second generation Fendt 1100 MT Series. The Fendt Momentum R32R30 will be available for order in the US and Canada from next summer. translationZh:
Fendt和Massey Ferguson均在2026年于爱荷华州布恩举行的Farm Progress展会上发布了新型播种机。虽然这两个AGCO旗下品牌都推出了新的播种机技术，但各自旨在解决客户的不同问题。Fendt提供的机器"专为追求更高生产力和效率的大规模农业经营而设计"。而Massey Ferguson则专注于打造简洁可靠的机械，并表示其新型播种机"结合了成熟技术、灵活性能和简便的拥有体验"。

**Massey Ferguson**

Massey Ferguson的新型N-Series分体窄行播种机配备了来自AGCO精准播种品牌PTx的工厂预装Precision Planting技术。PTx的20|20 Gen3农艺测绘系统、vSet2真空种子计量器（由其vDrive电动计量驱动装置提供动力）以及DeltaForce自动液压下压力控制系统均为N-Series播种机的标配。该公司表示，这与模块化设计相结合，"帮助农民在每次作业中获得更多收益，而不会增加操作的复杂性"。

这些播种机配备双45蒲式耳中央种子箱、可选配高达500加仑的液体肥料容量，以及驾驶室内手动重量转移功能，使操作员能够适应不断变化的田间条件。N-Series有六种配置，从23至32行播种，行间距为15至22英寸的窄间距。窄间距用于增加植株密度和提高粮食产量，最大化土地利用效率。它还减少了行内植株竞争，因为种子在每行内的间距更大。同样值得注意的是，更窄的间距意味着更多的行单元，因此这些机器的初始成本更高。

Massey Ferguson北美播种机营销经理Forrest Francis谈到了这款机器在美国市场可以发挥的作用。他说："农民想要成熟的技术，而不需要不必要的复杂性。""N-Series提供了生产者当今所需的性能，同时赋予他们随着经营规模扩大而灵活调整的能力。""关键是将技术用在能够产生有意义差异的地方，同时保持播种机易于拥有、操作和维护。"

据Massey Ferguson称，N-Series的重点是在播种季节之外提供长期价值。N-Series模块化平台允许生产者添加可选技术，包括WaveVision（在行单元底部的管道中计数种子，忽略灰尘、污垢和碎屑），该公司表示。其他技术如SpeedTube（用电动皮带系统替代重力落种管）也因该品牌使用Heads Up行单元而得以实现，该公司称其具有"更高的精度和更长的使用寿命"。

**Fendt**

Fendt正在扩展其Momentum播种机产品线，新增一款80英尺、32行、30英寸间距的播种机。Fendt Momentum32R30是该品牌迄今为止最大的播种机型号。这家德国品牌声称，新机型因其工作宽度而"每天覆盖更多英亩"，并因其标配的130蒲式耳高容量种子系统和1,000加仑肥料容量而减少了加种停歇。

该机器采用了三项成熟的AGCO技术：Fendt SmartFrame底盘，可实现主动地形仿形，无论洼地还是丘陵；工厂集成的Precision Planting系统（与Massey Ferguson的N-Series类似）；Load Logic重量管理系统，通过在整个机架宽度上更均匀地分配重量来减少压实行。该播种机"经过精心设计，以在每英亩土地上最大化生产力和播种性能"。

Fendt北美播种机高级营销经理Jason Lee谈到了Fendt希望通过新款Momentum播种机填补的市场空白。他说："大规模种植者需要在更紧的时间窗口内覆盖更多英亩，同时不牺牲推动产量潜力的精准度。""Fendt Momentum 32R30最大化农艺性能和效率以实现更好的产量，让每一粒种子都发挥作用。"

Momentum 32R30配备了新的五段式垂直仿形工具栏（VCT），Fendt表示，与之前的三段式版本相比，这增加了播种机更宽作业宽度上的工具栏灵活性。该机器实现了"一致的播种深度和均匀的种子放置"，因为VCT让行单元能够更紧密地跟随变化的地形。Fendt表示，该播种机与其大马力拖拉机产品线"高效"配合，包括Fendt 1000系列和新发布的第二代Fendt 1100 MT系列。Fendt Momentum R32R30将从明年夏季开始在美国和加拿大接受订购。
